title: Thin-Film Composite Reverse-Osmosis Membranes: Origin, Development, and Recent Advances
lineage: Selected passages paraphrased from the cited text.

passages.note: The inventors describe the Loeb–Sourirajan membrane as a thin selective surface integrally supported by a thicker porous layer. They discuss separately forming the selective and supporting layers as an approach to improving that design, recount work at North Star and FilmTec, and name NS-300 and FT-30 among the resulting composite membranes. Only the publisher-indexed abstract was inspected.
